unsupported_solver_reason: Abaqus/Standard Learning Edition 2025 rejects the instruction-compliant 1586-node assembly at both writeInput and job.submit because the edition is restricted to 1000 nodes.
visible_goal: Build and solve the specified block-on-plate contact assembly in ANSYS v261; report final interface CPRESS, block-top UZ, and plate-bottom RFZ metrics.
selection_reason: ANSYS v261 supports the exact 3/5 mm nonlinear contact model; the pinned Abaqus 2025 Learning Edition cannot submit its 1586 nodes, and AutoCAD is drafting-only.
